hero.caption:
Map of battlefield core and study areas.
The ABPP made substantial changes to the 1993 battlefield boundaries. Core Areas were added to reflect fighting on the western battlefield and the intense skirmishing that took place along the Confederate line of retreat.

The Study Area was expanded to accommodate the new Core Areas and to reflect all areas of military operation associated with the battle, especially the Federal army’s advance up the west side of the Cape Fear River.
